skins.name: Base Cherry
skins.desc: Az alap Cherry skin. Ranged Bloom Orb támadás és gyors Bloom Dash skill.

skins.name: Beastclaw Cherry
skins.desc: Közelharci karmolás és Savage Rend skill.

skins.name: Ninja Cherry
skins.desc: Két shurikent dobó ranged skin. A skill 360°-ban shurikeneket lő ki és ideiglenesen megnöveli a movement speedet.

skins.name: Succubus Cherry
skins.desc: Vörös karmolásokkal támad. A Soul Drain célkövető lelkekkel sebez, gyógyít, teljes HP-n pedig shieldet készít.

skins.name: Warrior Cherry
skins.desc: Közelharci kardforgató Cherry. A Whirlwind körbeforduló területi kardcsapásokkal sebzi a körülötte lévő ellenfeleket.

skins.name: Sakura Dance Cherry
skins.uniquePassive: +5% Movement Speed · +5% Attack Speed · Sakura petal trail
skins.desc: Legendary dual-sword melee skin. Every 10 defeated enemies reduces the remaining Blossom Spin cooldown by 30%. Sakura Dance Cherry moves 5% faster, attacks 5% faster, and leaves small fading sakura petals while walking. Blossom Spin cuts a medium area and grants a 2% movement-speed burst that fades to zero over one second.

skins.name: Mage Cherry
skins.desc: A staff-wielding ranged Cherry. Magical Shot releases five homing magic orbs; all five focus the same target when only one enemy is present.

skins.name: Archer Cherry
skins.desc: A mobile ranged Cherry. Her skill fires four arrows in a wide cone while her raised bow stays clear during movement.
